title: Output-root migration preview required an untracked legacy task directory

failing_environment.observed: Move-MIROutputRoots.ps1 failed before producing its idempotence preview because it unconditionally enumerated .mir/tasks, a retired untracked compatibility directory that happened to exist only in the long-lived main workspace.

reproduction.observed: The isolated branch contained every tracked repository file and no .mir/tasks directory. The same test appeared healthy in the main workspace only because disposable local state masked the assumption.

root_cause.summary: The output-root migration scans a retired task location for backward-compatible rewrites, but its enumerator did not guard the optional directory. Migration idempotence therefore depended on untracked workstation state.

repair_changes: treat an absent .mir/tasks legacy root as an empty migration input
retain scanning behavior when the legacy directory is present
restore the hidden-file upload opt-in for the .work development-candidate artifact
run static.layout from the clean isolated repair worktree
regression_propositions: output-root migration preview succeeds when .mir/tasks is absent
the preview remains idempotent in a fresh tracked-only worktree
every .work artifact upload explicitly includes hidden files
the exact development package archive and normalized content identities remain unchanged

closure.required: fresh-worktree static.layout, static.full, latest-head hosted gate, and merge to dev
closure.boundary: This is repository tooling only. It does not assign C32, advance 3.2.5 beyond planned, create 2.5.5 authority, admit 3.3, or modify published distribution authority.
